sam.lee: quick flag: pushed nebular-lite v1 to staging for embed onboarding. baseline vs candidate quick metrics look mixed.
rachel: numbers?
sam.lee: recall@1 0.59 -> 0.60 (tiny win), recall@10 0.82 -> 0.80 (small drop). silhouette avg 0.46 -> 0.41. cluster purity lower on kmeans(100).
devin: interesting that r@1 up but r@10 down. any change in neighbor distance distribution?
sam.lee: yes median cosine gap reduced (-0.01) but 95th pct increased (+0.08). means more very-distant neighbors.
rachel: that smells like fragmentation: some vectors too small or too noisy. what's the norm profile?
sam.lee: mean norm decreased 0.88 -> 0.73. std increased 0.18 -> 0.27. lots of low-norm tail.
devin: lower norms can push vectors closer in cosine space depending on scale. did you try bias-correction or renormalizing?
sam.lee: ran per-sample L2 renorm on 5k holdout: recall@10 recovered to 0.81, silhouette to 0.44. so renorm helps but not perfect.
rachel: was model trained with any new norm layer or loss weight change?
sam.lee: training changed a contrastive temp schedule (higher temp late). hypothesis: higher temp made embeddings collapse slightly in magnitude and enlarged variance.
devin: ok. quantization check?
sam.lee: quick PTQ int8 gave recall@10 0.76 and silhouette 0.35. tried per-channel calibration (20000 samples) via tool and it improved to r@10 0.79.
devin: please paste the quant command you used.
sam.lee: ```bash
calib-quant --model nebular-lite:v1 --mode per-channel --calib 20000 --out nebular-lite-int8-perc
```
ops-bot: deploy:staging succeeded for nebular-lite:v1 @2026-03-21T09:12:01Z
rachel: action items to proceed?
devin: 1) add an "embed-norm-check" step in onboarding that computes mean/std vs baseline and runs renorm probe. fail if mean delta < -0.08 or std delta > 0.1.
2) require per-channel quant calibration as part of int8 gating, with anchor-set recall@10 within -0.03 of baseline.
3) run recall stratified by freq (high/mid/tail) and by query length (short/long).
sam.lee: agree. ran short-query holdout: fp16 short-query r@1 dropped 0.53 -> 0.44, after renorm it's 0.51. tail freq drop concentrated in bottom 20% of corpus.
rachel: put renorm into the serving pipeline as an optional toggle for onboarding experiments. we should also surface norm stats in the console dashboard.
devin: i'll open a Jenkins job to run per-channel quant + stratified recall automatically on new artifacts. tagging @eng-infra for compute.
sam.lee: created ticket ENGML-1452 "nebular-lite onboarding: norm probe + per-channel quant gating". i'll upload eval json and plots here when complete.
ops-bot: ticket ENGML-1452 created and assigned to sam.lee
